news.title: ‘I will kill y'all’: Middle school student arrested for gun on Cobb campus
news.summary: A student brought a gun to Campbell Middle School in Smyrna on Tuesday, just seven days into the new school year.

news.title: Former Dallas police 911 director accused of Flock camera misuse
news.summary: A former Dallas Police Department 911 director was arrested and accused of misusing the Flock license plate reader system, according to the Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI).

news.title: 2 Lawrenceville men tied to prison drop plot, sheriff says
news.summary: Two Lawrenceville men were arrested in central Georgia for an attempted prison drop in March, according to authorities.

news.title: Violent criminal sentenced to prison for trafficking large amounts of fentanyl, meth in Gwinnett
news.summary: Based on evidence presented in court, 46-year-old Gabriel Ojeda Murguia sold fentanyl and methamphetamine on several occasions in Gwinnett County for a year.

news.title: How you can help Colombia earthquake survivors from metro Atlanta
news.summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake hit Colombia, leaving over 200 dead as a metro Atlanta restaurant collects relief supplies.

news.title: Do you recognize him? Sandy Springs police release enhanced photos of wanted man
news.summary: Sandy Springs police need help identifying a man wanted in a sexual battery investigation after releasing surveillance photos.

news.title: 'I just want to bury my baby': Atlanta mom holds hope after 20 years
news.summary: Atlanta mother Tangela Harris continues searching for her missing daughter, Artdrunetta Hobbs, who vanished 20 years ago.

news.title: Reward offered after scooter stolen in southwest Atlanta robbery
news.summary: Authorities said the incident occurred around 2:23 a.m. on Sunday, Aug. 9, near 2840 Martin Luther King Jr. Dr. SW, which appears to be the address of the Scottish Inns Atlanta hotel.

news.title: Fourth arrest made in case of Atlanta man killed, found dumped in Douglas County reservoir
news.summary: The Douglas County Sheriff's Office said a deceased male was first recovered from Dog River Reservoir on May 15.

news.title: Third person charged in metro Atlanta illegal tire dumping investigation
news.summary: A 51-year-old woman has been arrested in connection with an ongoing investigation into illegal tire dumping, according to the sheriff’s office.

news.title: Shooting outside Mall of Georgia leaves 1 injured; man arrested
news.summary: An innocent bystander was wounded outside a Buford business Sunday when an intoxicated man fired a handgun into the ground following his removal from the venue, authorities said.

news.title: Police presence in Conyers residential neighborhood
news.summary: Conyers Police said Wednesday they were assisting the Cobb County Police Department in executing an arrest/search warrant.
